tradable_capital_cap.rule: sizing draws from min(MAX_EXPOSURE_KRW, min(base, free_balance)); profit above base is set aside and never re-risked (no compounding of profit)
tradable_capital_cap.drawdown_choice: tradable = min(base, free_balance) — below base, trade the reduced balance (never deploy more than base, nor money not held); no separate lockbox that survives the account falling below base
tradable_capital_cap.wired: RiskManager.tradable_capital()/protected_profit(); can_open(free_balance)/gap_capped_notional(free_balance); donchian_bot.py deploys min(BASE,cash) per entry for both books

forward_equity_anchor.why: forward paper equity was recomputed over a sliding ~250-candle window, so a persisted equity value stepped when an old trade left the window (observed 2026-09-19: a 4h row jumped +11.0%->-0.4% with no trade). Now pinned: pre-anchor bars are warmup only; books start at CAPITAL/FLAT at the anchor, so equity(T) is stable across runs (verified: 0 mismatches on window-shift). Track regenerated from anchor; old sliding files in logs/paper_*.cycle13slide.bak.

forward_track_since_anchor.daily: +0.0% (7 rows, 0 trades — flat at anchor, no breakout yet)

execution_model: resting exchange-side stop orders (Cycle 13, DEFAULT): entry buy-stop at prior n_in-bar high, exit sell-stop at channel-low / ATR-trail; fill intrabar WITHOUT the agent -> outage-immune up to config.MAX_BLIND_HOURS (~5h). Legacy next-open fills ('--exec market') remain but are gap-exposed. Entry sizing gap-capped via RiskManager.gap_capped_notional so a blind-window drop cannot breach the daily loss limit.

mitigation_resting_stops.daily: CAGR 80.7->60.2%, maxDD 48.5->44.3% (gap-proof, lower DD, gives back CAGR vs close-based ATR trail)

gap_robustness_cycle13.staleness_guard: rejected as standalone (degenerates to 0 trades under a persistent outage); only a filter for occasional delays
gap_robustness_cycle13.reconciliation: inherent — runner recomputes intended state from all closed candles each run, converges idempotently (self-heals a missed window without chasing)

risk_input.cap: naked notional <= DAILY_LOSS_LIMIT/BLIND_WORST_MOVE (~384k KRW); with a resting stop the bound is the stop distance. At the 200k/trade limit a 13% blind move = 26k < 50k limit, already gap-safe.

forward_validation_power.takeaway: 4h is the faster route to statistical confirmation (~2y vs ~5y) due to ~5x trade frequency; forward track is a live-execution/regime sanity check, the 9y walk-forward remains the primary edge evidence. See backtest/cycle11_power.py.

current_best_strategy: daily Donchian 20/20 + ATR(14) trail k=3 + optional volatility-target sizing (2%/day); 4h 30/20 validated co-best
objective: maximize risk-adjusted return (Calmar = CAGR/maxDD), validated out-of-sample across regimes

dataset.integrity: verify_data.py: 0 dup/out-of-order; daily 0 gaps; 4h 3 missing candles (0.015%); OHLC sane; tz=UTC (+9h vs KST verified); extreme moves = real events (2020 COVID, 2017 bubble)

volatility_target_sizing.effect: At the OOS-validated 2%/day: TEST Calmar 2.14->2.31, maxDD 19%->17%, CAGR ~flat. Cycle 10: paper runner aligned to 2%/day (was 2.5%); it now logs BOTH a full-exposure and a vol-target-sized paper equity side-by-side (equity_full_krw / equity_voltgt_krw) so the two can be compared as the forward track grows. Optional overlay, never scales above full exposure, 1M cap still the hard limit.

best_config.note: Entry on break above prior 20-bar high; exit on break below prior 20-bar low OR an ATR(14) trailing stop at k=3 below the running high since entry (Cycle 6: improves risk-adjusted return, cuts maxDD, CAGR intact). Representative params — the FAMILY is robust but exact channel length drifts across folds; do not over-trust the point estimate. REGIME FILTER (SMA100/200) was tested and REJECTED (hurt returns).

best_metrics_cycle6_atr_trail_k3.vs_base: base 20/20 TEST Calmar 1.93 / maxDD 22% -> ATR-trail k3 TEST Calmar 2.14 / maxDD 19%

validated_alternative_4h.atr_trailing_stop: TESTED Cycle 7 (single split) AND walk-forward (5 folds) — NOT adopted on 4h. k3 beat base in only 2/5 folds; k5 marginal/inert. Exit-design win from Cycle 6 is daily-specific. Keep 4h as plain Donchian 30/20.
validated_alternative_4h.note: On the EXTENDED 9y 4h data this now validates OOS (Calmar 1.93) with ~4x more trades than daily -> statistically stronger. Cycle-3's '4h overfits' was a short-data artifact.

robustness_cycle4.interpretation: Edge is real and concentrated in DOWNSIDE PROTECTION (avoids deep bear drawdowns), not long-BTC beta. Lags in raging bulls.

caveats: Single asset (BTC/KRW), long-only, low frequency (~5 trades/yr).
Optimal Donchian length drifts across folds; treat 20/20 as representative.
Daily open fills modeled with fee only (BTC/KRW daily liquidity is deep).
Past regimes may not repeat; still the strongest, most regime-robust result.

superseded.scalping_mean_reversion: Cycles 1-2: window120/z3/trend720. Break-even ceiling (-0.35% OOS), edge < fee. Abandoned for live use.

paper_bot: src/donchian_bot.py — research/PAPER-ONLY forward-runner. Fetches Upbit public candles, replays the strategy over closed candles (paper book = 1M KRW, next-open fills, 0.05%/side) and appends one row per closed candle to logs/paper_<tf>.csv (idempotent; re-run appends 0). Cycle 9: vol-target sizing wired in + current BUY intent gated by the shared RiskManager (HALT kill switch + 1M cap enforced; --mode paper only, no live path). Cycle 10: daily target aligned to 2%/day and the runner now logs TWO parallel books on the same signals — equity_full_krw (all-in) and equity_voltgt_krw (vol-target sized) — so full vs vol-target can be compared as the track grows (old 2.5%/single-column files kept as logs/paper_*.cycle9.bak). Cycle 13: DEFAULT execution switched to gap-robust RESTING stop orders (fills at levels intrabar, outage-immune; '--exec market' keeps legacy next-open); BUY intent now reports the resting buy-stop level + protective stop distance + gap-capped size; track regenerated in resting mode (old market track kept as logs/paper_*.cycle12market.bak). run_donchian_paper.sh runs both TFs (EXEC=market to override); cadence invocation-driven. Cycle 14: forward equity pinned to a fixed anchor (2026-09-12) so the persisted curve is stable across runs (was a sliding-window recompute that stepped when old trades left the window). Track SINCE ANCHOR (honest forward record): daily +0.0% / 0 trades (flat at anchor, no breakout yet); 4h +3.5% / 1 open trade (LONG). No keys.
